title_original: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Registration of Real Estate Rules) <Supreme Court Regulation No. 2931, November 26, 2020>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on December 10, 2020.

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Rules)
(1) through (3) Omitted.

(4) The Rules on Granting Fixed Dates on Housing Lease Contracts and Provision of Information shall be partially amended as follows:

Article 6 (4) 1 shall read as follows:
1. Individual: A certificate under Article 2, subparagraph 6 of the Electronic Signature Act capable of confirming the signer's real name.
